title: Multi-Genre Workshop
description: Seminar across multiple and blended genres.
notes: May be offered as a joint undergraduate and graduate class.
Intended for undergraduate Writing Majors who will complete degree requirements by December.
With permission of department, this course may be used in lieu of one of WRIT 401, WRIT 402, WRIT 403, WRIT 416, or WRIT 418 in the BA or BFA Writing Major program.
